description:
Recent Energy Performance Certificates for a property, newest first:
    up to five mart certificates and up to five raw certificates. Raw readings
    include exact certificate URL/address, floor level, top-storey indicator,
    rooms, area and source dates. Compare source vintages; raw certificates may
    be newer than the property summary. Unknown floor codes remain unknown;
    habitable rooms are not bedrooms. Changes between certificates do not alone
    prove building works or a measured-area change.

    Each carries a `retrofit_gap`, or null where it cannot be computed. Null
    means unknown, NOT zero — a zero gap means the property is already at its
    potential, which is a different claim.

    No certificate is a real answer, not a failure: EPCs are lodged on sale or
    let, so a long-held property may never have had one.

    UK only. Free. Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: epc_certificates
title: EPC certificates for a property
